name: libopenshot-audio
description: OpenShot Audio Library (libopenshot-audio) is a free, open-source project that enables high-quality editing and playback of audio, and is based on the amazing JUCE library.

issues.title: live sound recording support to OpenShot

latest_release.body:
## Highlights & Features

- **Windows ARM64 support:** Add native audio-library build readiness and compatible alignment queries for the Windows ARM toolchain.
- **Native ARM64 validation:** Automatically check Linux and Windows ARM64 builds, with improved dependency validation and CI compatibility.
- **Stable ABI:** Version 1.0.2 keeps **SO 10 unchanged** and provides the audio dependency required by libopenshot 1.1.0.
